emfAttributes.Global_Title: 2025 02 Boldest Innovations - Active Suspension, So good it was banned!

metadata.longDescription: Active suspension was key to Nigel Mansell's world championship win in 1992, but just how did this bold innovation come about and, as many people claim, did it really make the FW14B the most technologically advanced car ever? Will Buxton and Sam Collins explore just this, and along with former Williams team members Paddy Lowe and Frank Dernie, as well as Nigel Mansell, this episode will break down the work that went on behind the scenes to get this car to the track.

emfAttributes.Global_Title: Boldest Innovations - Was the double diffuser key to Brawn's success?

metadata.longDescription: In 2009, Jenson button won the world championship in Brawn's debut season with a very bold innovation, the double diffuser. Just how crucial was it to the team's success, how did it come about and how did their rivals attempt to compete with the car's clear advantage? Will Buxton and Sam Collins discuss all of this with the team behind the engineering, we hear from Ross Brawn and meet one of the aero dynamists who worked on the car's development to uncover the stories behind their domination.
